tours.reuse: Exact four sealed label-free persistent tour payloads, offsets/counts/generator receipts after root custody audit
tours.sampling: Randomized DFS spanning forest, not uniform spanning tree
tours.component_reset: Zero initial state per component and direction, no state across calls/steps
tours.directions: Two separate unidirectional calls with identical weights and biases; reverse each component independently
tours.node_readout: Mean over ALL occurrences of each node of (forward+reverse)/2
tours.equivariance: No exact fixed-seed per-realization ID equivariance/invariance claim

memory.cell: PyTorch reset-after GRU, explicitly not faithful reset-before GRUBE

initialization.fast: All ones, explicit new staged recipe; no historical initializer conclusion
initialization.bias: All zero except input update/retention gate z +log99
initialization.retention: Nominal .99 at zero learned affine contribution; sign differs from primary GRUBE candidate-weight update convention
initialization.slow_init_seed: block+459000131+1000003*b; b0 common across all shared/tied controls; GI16 uses b=0..3

readout.initial_function: Selected P1 at stage2 checkpoint0 in exact arithmetic; not bitwise certification or subsequent DEVELOPMENT retention
readout.gate_gradient_delay: Zero W_o makes first-update gate gradient zero; disclosed and shared by equipped controls

control_ownership.B4: One acquired ordinary stem/decoder, four no-memory tail contexts; mean own CE, tied everything
control_ownership.G1: One ordinary complete same-GRU parameter/bias/readout set over four tours
control_ownership.GF1: One memory-factor parameter/bias set over four tours; no private view rows
control_ownership.GM4: One common acquired P1 H/native decoder/readout; four private memory gate factor/bias sets; memberm takes tourm
control_ownership.GN4: Same GRU/tours/readout; ordinary memory gates/bias shared; four live native fast-factor routes and private additive bias offsets; all native slow first maps/bias frozen, common slow second maps/bias live; first dropout disabled; ones factors/zero offsets
control_ownership.GI16: Four wholly separate ordinary G1 bodies; each own acquired P1 ancestor, decoder, GRU, readout, optimizer/selector/stop; each own four tours; serve16 final probabilities
control_ownership.GA4: Additional probability mean of four acquired ordinary P1 ancestors; no fit trajectory; own scalar CAL endpoint
control_ownership.capacity_limit: GM4 and GN4 are not private-capacity matched. Placement result is whole specified allocation package.
control_ownership.between_arm_ownership: Every comparison arm has its own live parameters, optimizer and selected state; fixed P1 stem/H ancestors may be reused read-only after custody audit

learning.optimizer: Fresh source TF1Adam stage2, LR.001,beta1.9,beta2.999,eps1e-8 before correction,float32 powers
learning.loss: Mean own TRAIN CE plus one/mean source first-layer penalty; never CE of pooled probabilities
learning.selector: Latest tied min total SELECT CE+penalty, including checkpoint0;50 strictly worse consecutive totals or100000update ceiling
learning.tail_seed: block+459000151+1000003*b+1009*j; body0 paired across stage controls
learning.streaming: Accumulate each of four view backward contributions before one optimizer update; no effective-weight cache across updates, detaching or BPTT truncation
learning.genuine_independent: Four independent full stage2 trajectories and SELECT stops; no shared parameters
learning.release: All new fits close and selected states export, then all new CAL endpoints close, then one complete DEVELOPMENT release
learning.paired_rng_ownership: Paired initial seeds across arms, separate generator objects/states; no shared mutable RNG

serving_and_CAL.raw: Class-probability mean; no logit averaging or selected tour
serving_and_CAL.CAL: float64 CPU Adam LR.05,500steps,logTstart0,clamp[-5,5],latest tied min CAL NLL over0..500
serving_and_CAL.temperature_application: mean softmax(member_logprob/T), over4 members/views, or16 body-views forGI16

proposed_gates.status: Root admission needed before any acquisition, not retrospective outcome claims
proposed_gates.raw: GM4 minus every reference >=.20pp mean and strictly positive in every block
proposed_gates.member: Mean GM4member accuracy minus mean GI16BODY accuracy >=-.25pp mean and no block below-.50pp; each GI16body serves its own four-view probability mean
proposed_gates.confidence: CAL NLL <=reference+.005nat in every block for every raw reference, and GM4mean <=best reference mean
proposed_gates.cost: Report measured paid acquisition/cache/BPTT/SELECT/restore/export/CAL/serving/packing and peak memory; no storage-to-speed implication
proposed_gates.failure: Any primary raw/member failure closes exact GM4 package; no rescue grid
proposed_gates.single_augmentation: G1/GF1 versus P1 and B4 also tests general GNN improvement independently of ensemble superiority
proposed_gates.diagnostics: Whole-population repairs/harms/C/L/A with delta_correct=delta_C-delta_L+delta_A; inherited fixed common-rival cohorts descriptive only

counts.training_horizons: Unknown until whole acquisition; counts do not estimate Adam steps/wall time

implementation.nomination: Version-pinned _VF.gru tensor-list entry used by nn.GRU.forward, with live differentiable effective weights, not copied/new leaf Parameters
implementation.packed_components: Immutable label-free packed gather/inverse maps and separate within-component reverse permutation; zero h0 for every packed component
implementation.kernels: API calls not kernel counts; long serial critical path persists
implementation.weight_packing: Unflattened tensor list can be backend-packed; source autograd explicitly returns original weight-list gradients
implementation.gradient_chain_rule: dA_ij +=s_i*rx_j*G_Aij; drx_j=sum_i s_i*A_ij*G_Aij; ds_i=sum_j(A_ij*rx_j*G_Aij+B_ij*rh_j*G_Bij); drh analogous; shared gradients sum across members/directions
forbidden_substitutes: reuse effective tensors after Adam update
implementation.public_wrapper_caution: functional_call refreshes and may flatten GRU weights in-place under no_grad; derived nonleaf behavior must be qualified, not assumed
implementation.evidence_version: Official PyTorch v2.1.2 source only; allocation runtime and gradient/dispatch/peak remain unqualified
